claim: The parasite that causes African sleeping sickness can be transmitted from mammals to tsetse flies in two stages of its lifecycle.
source: The parasite that causes African sleeping sickness can be transmitted from mammals to tsetse flies in two stages of its lifecycle, rather than one as was previously thought.
evidence: This is stated as a factual finding in the abstract of the manuscript.
